info.name: Telegram Integration - Neuro Engine
info.description: API endpoints for Telegram Bot integration. Share presentation slides directly to Telegram chats.

request.description:
# Telegram Integration Setup

## Step 1: Create Telegram Bot
1. Open Telegram and search for @BotFather
2. Send `/newbot` command
3. Follow instructions to create your bot
4. Copy the bot token (e.g., `123456789:ABCdefGHIjklMNOpqrsTUVwxyz`)
5. Add token to `.env` file as `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`

## Step 2: Get Your Chat ID
1. Start a conversation with your bot on Telegram
2. Send any message to the bot
3. Visit: `https://api.telegram.org/bot<YOUR_BOT_TOKEN>/getUpdates`
4. Find your chat ID in the JSON response: `"chat":{"id":123456789}`
5. Save this chat ID for connecting

## Step 3: Test Connection
Use this request to verify bot is configured correctly.

Get information about the configured Telegram bot.

Returns:
- Bot ID
- Bot username
- Bot first name
- Bot link for users to start conversation

Connect your Telegram account by providing your chat ID.

Before calling this endpoint:
1. Start a conversation with your bot
2. Get your chat ID from bot updates
3. Provide the chat ID in the request body

The backend will:
- Verify the chat ID is valid
- Store the connection in your user profile
- Send a test message to confirm

Request Body:
```json
{
  "chatId": "123456789"
}
```

Check if user has connected their Telegram account.

Returns:
- `connected`: Boolean indicating connection status
- `profile`: Telegram profile information (if connected)
- `connectedAt`: Timestamp of when connection was established

Share a presentation slide to your Telegram chat.

The backend will:
1. Fetch the presentation and slide
2. Download the slide image
3. Format the slide content (title, subtitle, bullet points)
4. Send to your Telegram chat with image and caption

Request Body:
```json
{
  "presentationId": "abc-123-def",
  "slideIndex": 0,
  "message": "Optional custom message"
}
```

Note:
- `message` is optional
- Slide must have an image
- Caption includes slide title, text, and Neuro Engine branding

Share custom content with external image URL.

Useful for:
- Sharing images from other sources
- Testing the sharing functionality
- Custom content not in presentations

Request Body:
```json
{
  "imageUrl": "https://example.com/image.jpg",
  "message": "Your custom message here"
}
```

The backend will:
1. Download image from provided URL
2. Send to Telegram with your message
3. Add Neuro Engine branding

Send a simple text message to your Telegram chat.

Supports Markdown formatting:
- `*bold*` or `**bold**`
- `_italic_` or `__italic__`
- `[link text](URL)`
- `` `code` ``
- ```` ```code block``` ````

Request Body:
```json
{
  "message": "Your message with *Markdown* support"
}
```

Disconnect your Telegram account.

This will:
- Remove chat ID from your profile
- Clear Telegram profile information
- Disable sharing until reconnected

You can reconnect anytime by calling the connect endpoint again.
